scope: semantic developmental quotient + resource-bounded realization + inductive-bias/proposal geometry + bounded morphogenetic search

rows.name: Pareto admissibility
rows.statement: Among morphologies realizing the same registered semantic obligation at matched capability, any realization weakly worse on every registered raw resource coordinate and strictly worse on at least one is realization-dominated.

rows.name: Price-conditioned ranking reversal
rows.statement: If two feasible realizations have incomparable nonnegative resource vectors, different prospectively declared nonnegative price vectors can prefer different realizations.
assumptions: linear nonnegative scalarization for the stated version

rows.name: Affine lifetime horizon crossover
rows.statement: For C_i(H)=A_i+H c_i, if A_1>A_2 and c_1<c_2, the unique crossover is H*=(A_1-A_2)/(c_2-c_1).
assumptions: constant expected per-use costs over registered regime

rows.name: Discovery-cost reversal
rows.statement: A realization with lower serving burden is worse in complete lifetime burden when its extra discovery/build burden exceeds all serving savings over the registered effective horizon.

rows.name: Normative optimum does not imply discoverability
rows.statement: An oracle optimum over the admissible realization class does not imply a bounded developmental/morphogenetic search can identify or reach it.
assumptions: normative candidate class distinguished from search process
rows.gmi_role: separates realization frontier from morphogenetic search

rows.name: Semantic admissibility precedes efficiency
rows.statement: A resource-efficient candidate that does not preserve the registered semantic obligation is not an admissible realization and cannot occupy the realization frontier.
assumptions: semantic obligation fixed before resource comparison
rows.gmi_role: prevents weakening correctness to win efficiency

rows.name: Realization equivalence does not imply resource equivalence
rows.statement: Two morphologies can implement the same semantic developmental state and future semantic traces while occupying different capability-resource frontiers.
rows.gmi_role: supports morphology comparison after semantic quotienting

rows.name: Morphology phase boundaries are ecology-relative
rows.statement: If the preferred frontier occupant changes only after changing ecology, horizon, verifier strength, hardware/resource prices, drift or development protocol, the transition is conditional on those registered variables rather than evidence of a universally superior morphology.
assumptions: candidate set and comparison semantics held fixed except registered phase variable
rows.parent_owner: statistical decision theory / algorithm selection / bounded rationality

rows.name: Search quality and realization quality are independent axes
rows.statement: A morphogenetic process can cheaply find a poor realization or expensively find an excellent realization; reporting only deployment quality or only search cost is insufficient for developmental comparison.
assumptions: search/discovery burden is accounted separately from realized serving/update burden
rows.parent_owner: AutoML / NAS / program synthesis evaluation methodology

rows.name: No universal best realization
rows.statement: GMI-v1 does not license one morphology as universally optimal across unrestricted ecologies/resource valuations; any strong dominance claim is scoped to a registered obligation/ecology/resource regime.

rows.name: Semantic-state information lower bound and factorization interpretation
rows.statement: For a finite exact semantic sufficient-state set with N pairwise future-distinguishable states, a lossless fixed-length binary encoding requires at least ceil(log2 N) bits. Thus N=3^n implies Theta(n) state-information bits, not Theta(3^n). Any exponential factorization advantage must identify another quantity such as global model/transition enumeration, search enumeration, or update/revision work.
assumptions: pairwise future-distinguishable under the registered obligation
fixed-length binary encoding for the stated bound
rows.gmi_role: separates state information from model/update complexity

rows.name: Semantic quotient factorization
rows.statement: For a fixed finite deterministic obligation, if an exact realization encoding e identifies only future-semantically equivalent developmental situations, then the canonical semantic quotient map factors uniquely through e on reachable encoded states.
rows.parent_owner: Myhill-Nerode / minimal sufficient state / predictive-state / bisimulation quotient mathematics

rows.name: Minimum exact semantic-state cardinality and uniqueness
rows.statement: Every exact finite realization has at least as many reachable encoded state identities as the semantic quotient classes. If equality holds, its reachable state partition is isomorphic to the semantic quotient.
assumptions: no uncounted side channel carrying semantic distinctions
rows.gmi_role: replaces unsupported universal local-atom claim with task-relative canonical semantic state

rows.name: Demand-only morphology selection is non-identifiable
rows.statement: An obligation-side demand signature alone cannot determine a unique optimal morphology when legal realization response functions, resource/hardware regimes, available candidate families or bounded morphogenetic search can vary.
assumptions: same semantic obligation may admit multiple exact realizations
realization costs or availability are not fixed by the demand signature alone
rows.parent_owner: decision theory / algorithm selection / resource rationality
rows.gmi_role: corrects phase target to demand x realization response x resources x search

rows.name: Known-form derivation is morphology-language dependent
rows.statement: The semantic quotient does not uniquely imply neural, symbolic, Bayesian or programmatic realization. Specific known forms require additional carrier, transformation, update and/or morphogenetic assumptions. Expressibility, discoverability and frontier usefulness are distinct.
assumptions: semantic state separated from realization language
bounded morphogenetic process distinguished from expressibility
rows.parent_owner: computability / programming-language realization / AutoML / neuroevolution / architecture search
rows.gmi_role: formalizes conditional generation of known machine-intelligence forms

rows.name: Finite bias-ecology crossover
rows.statement: For finite target universe F, structured subset T with alpha=|T|/|F|, subset-average scores a_T and a_N, and full-universe average b=alpha*a_T+(1-alpha)*a_N, the ecology mixture score s(p)=p*a_T+(1-p)*a_N obeys s(p)-b=(p-alpha)*(a_T-a_N). Thus a bias benefiting T crosses its full-universe baseline exactly at p=alpha.
assumptions: uniform sampling within T and its complement
registered score linear under ecology mixture
rows.gmi_role: architecture-neutral finite phase relation connecting bias alignment to ecology prevalence

rows.name: Semantic proposal pushforward invariance under native refinement
rows.statement: When a native proposal distribution is pushed through a fixed semantic candidate map, splitting one native candidate into multiple variants with the same semantic effect and preserving their total probability mass leaves the semantic proposal distribution unchanged.
assumptions: native split variants map to the same semantic class
rows.gmi_role: prevents syntactic/native candidate duplication from manufacturing stronger cross-paradigm bias

rows.name: K1 operationalized as pre-solution semantic proposal-geometry change
rows.statement: For a fresh semantic target set absent from relevant history, K1 cognition-generation capital requires matched-control evidence that history improves a registered pre-solution semantic target probability/surprisal, first-hit burden, proposal rank, or burden-indexed hit distribution before target success; final outcome improvement alone is insufficient.
assumptions: fresh target/solution not present in relevant history
semantic candidate map frozen before outcome
rows.parent_owner: search bias / Bayesian priors / proposal distributions / ranking / hitting-time analysis
rows.gmi_role: common K1 measurement contract across program search, proof search, coding, neural proposals and OCM
